sourceTitle: NASA’s First Weather Report From Jezero Crater on Mars
rights: NASA/JPL factual report; cite the source. No source photography is redistributed here.
snapshotNote: Reviewed through the published JPL page. Direct archive download returned HTTP 403; no retained source bytes or invented checksum.
location: At Perseverance in Jezero crater during each observation period; exact sensor coordinates are not established by the report.

observations.dateLabel: April 3–4, 2021 · sols 43–44 as reported by JPL

limitations: Historical local observations, not a live forecast or planet-wide measurement.
Published summary rather than calibrated PDS time-series analysis; sensor height, exact timestamps and uncertainty are not supplied here.
The two observation windows are separate; do not combine them into one weather state or apply them to trip eligibility.
Pressure is reported only for the first session; wind is approximate and reported only for sols 43–44.
